consequence.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for verifying image signatures in the sigstore bundle format through the new verification type `SigstoreBundle`; existing policies are unaffected unless they opt in.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for verifying container image signatures in the sigstore bundle format (for example, GitHub Artifact Attestations) through the verification type `SigstoreBundle`.
